target.statement: With set.seed(1863) in R, for normal data with n=500 and two contaminated points (5 and 6), Tukey's boxplot labels 3 suspected outliers and the Chauvenet-type boxplot labels 2 suspected outliers.
target.dataset: Simulated standard normal data with two contaminated points (5 and 6), n=500, seed=1863

compute.basis: Simulation of 500 normal variates and two outliers, then applying two simple boxplot rules; trivial computation on any laptop.

title: When Tukey meets Chauvenet: a new boxplot criterion for outlier detection
